name: RA 11166
detail: The Philippine HIV and AIDS Policy Act (2018), implemented by government and PNAC, strengthens a rights-based response. The law addresses testing confidentiality, protection against discrimination, age-appropriate education, accessible ART, community prevention, and collaboration.

name: DOH National HIV, AIDS & STI Program
detail: Program activities include confidential testing, ART for enrolled patients, safer-sex education, awareness campaigns, and expanded access to PrEP and PEP.

name: OPLAN PROPEL
detail: A DOH initiative to expand prevention, diagnosis, and treatment through stronger healthcare delivery, coordinated action, and community participation.

name: KonsulTayo & Health is Life
focus: Health literacy, care access & sexual health
detail: KonsulTayo encourages people to seek primary care and understand available services. Health is Life promotes healthy behaviors, including safe sex and sexual and reproductive health. Both are DOH flagship health education campaigns.

name: SHIP
detail: Sustained Health Initiatives of the Philippines supports community health, key populations, awareness, access to testing information, and dissemination of HIV surveillance resources.

name: Pilipinas Shell Foundation
detail: PSFI collaborates with agencies, NGOs, and local governments. Its activities include Champion Community Centers, condom and lubricant distribution, PrEP and PEP awareness, and outreach.

name: The Red Whistle
detail: Creative campaigns, social media, educational materials, advocacy against discrimination, community collaborations, and encouragement to seek testing and treatment.

name: RAJAH Community Centre
focus: A safe space in Iloilo City
detail: Founded by FPOP, RAJAH is a primary HIV clinic with services including counselling, telemedicine, mobile clinics, PrEP, condoms, and psychosocial support.

name: AHF Philippines
detail: Supports 27 health care sites, including eight with combination prevention services. Partners include community groups, local governments, LoveYourself, and San Lazaro Hospital.
